liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Standing On The Moon** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls this the best Standing on the Moon, with Jerry's voice priceless in a hilarious way; Autzen 93 ranked first; Reviewer says Jerry sang it with plenty of heart, but it isn't among the best [8][12]
- **Let The Good Times Roll** (1 review): Reviewer says the reprise was led by Weir rather than Jerry [9]
- **Cumberland Blues** (1 review): Reviewer found it lifeless and weak, worse than bar band versions [9]
- **Don't Ease Me In** (1 review): Reviewer calls it the night's best song and the only time Jerry seemed present [9]
- **Iko Iko** (1 review): Second-set Iko Iko was an extended version [4]

## The recordings

- **gd94-06-24.sturtevant.cribbs.13443.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 19 songs; 173 min; rated 2.77/5 by 22 [1]. Said about its sound: Audience recording with good sound that reviewer recognizes as typical of the Silver Bowl; Pretty clean mix; Reviewer wishes a better copy of the show existed [4][5][13][14]
- **gd1994-06-24.fob.schoeps.byron.dauria.97302.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 172 min [2]

## Around the show

- Temperature peaked around 125 degrees; breeze felt like an oven door opening beside you [3]
- Some fans were disappointed the middle night featured many new songs, but reviewer felt they were played well [3]
- Temperatures around 105 during the show; reviewer was surprised the shows went ahead because of the heat [4]
- Fans collapsed from heat throughout the three days, often two or three times daily in front of the reviewer [6]
- Jerry looked slimmed down and bouncier on this tour; heat wasn't an issue for the reviewer [8]
- Heat reached 125 on the field; people tried selling nitrous balloons in the dusty lot [12]
- Heat was unreal, and sprinklers helped; this was the reviewer's first Dead show [13]
- Reviewer found the show lifeless, with Jerry barely present and Vince's vocals and keyboard poor [14]
- Reviewer ranked this weekend as their favorite of all their Dead shows; band was on top of it throughout [3]
- Reviewer remembers this show as not very exciting [7]
- The whole Vegas run was tight, according to the reviewer [8]
- Reviewer prefers the 9-26-93 and 8-21-93 versions of Standing on the Moon [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd94-06-24.sturtevant.cribbs.13443.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Neil Sturtevant; transferred by Neil Sturtevant and Sean Cribbs; source: Audience: Sennheiser K3U/ME80's [1]. Also: Neil Sturtevant transferred the DAT to untracked CD; Sean Cribbs extracted with EAC, tracked in CD Wave, converted to SHN [1]
- **gd1994-06-24.fob.schoeps.byron.dauria.97302.flac16**: taped by Eliot Byron; transferred by Frank D'Auria; source: Scheops CMC5/MK4->Sonosax SX-M2->ApogeeD1000??->Sony D10 [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Michael Mullen Grateful Dead: [1994-06-24 Sam Boyd Silver Bowl, U.N.L.V., Las Vegas, NV, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1994-06-24-sam-boyd-silver-bowl-u-n-l-v-las-vegas-nv-usa/) [16]
- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1994-06-25 Sam Boyd Silver Bowl, U.N.L.V., Las Vegas, NV, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1994-06-25-sam-boyd-silver-bowl-u-n-l-v-las-vegas-nv-usa/) [17]
- Poster by Michael Mullen Grateful Dead: [1994-06-24 Sam Boyd Silver Bowl, U.N.L.V., Las Vegas, NV, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1994-06-24-sam-boyd-silver-bowl-u-n-l-v-las-vegas-nv-usa/) [18]
